final_message:
Configured the 31 authoritative zones on pc1–pc31 as assigned, with 30 delegations and their glue records. The recursive resolver is pc32 (`10.15.8.14`); pc33–pc40 use it as their DNS server.

The requested service and MX records are in place. I assumed the web service for `www.example.com` is on pc6 (`10.15.2.12`). All DNS servers already used `kathara/base`, so no image changes were needed.

Static checks passed for the zone assignments, delegations, glue, service addresses and MX targets. BIND validation tools were unavailable locally, and runtime resolution has not been tested.
